title: Short exact sequences of finite locally free modules split locally
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $0\to\mathcal E_1\to\mathcal E_2\to\mathcal E_3\to0$ be a short exact sequence, where each $\mathcal E_i$ is locally free of constant finite rank $r_i$ in the sense of [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. There is an open cover $\{U_a\}$ of $X$ such that, on every $U_a$, the sequence is isomorphic to the split sequence $0\to\mathcal E_1|_{U_a}\to(\mathcal E_1|_{U_a})\oplus(\mathcal E_3|_{U_a})\to\mathcal E_3|_{U_a}\to0$.

source.place: Proof of (*), determinant paragraph: local splitting

proof.text: For each point of $X$, apply the local-section statement to the quotient map $q$ and shrink to an open neighbourhood $U_a$ carrying a section $s_a:\mathcal E_3|_{U_a}\to\mathcal E_2|_{U_a}$ with $q\circ s_a=\mathrm{id}$.

source.place: Proof of (*), determinant paragraph: local splitting

proof.text: On such a $U_a$, define $\Phi_a:(\mathcal E_1|_{U_a})\oplus(\mathcal E_3|_{U_a})\to\mathcal E_2|_{U_a}$ by $\Phi_a(e_1,e_3)=u(e_1)+s_a(e_3)$. Define $\Psi_a:\mathcal E_2|_{U_a}\to(\mathcal E_1|_{U_a})\oplus(\mathcal E_3|_{U_a})$ by $\Psi_a(e)=(e-s_a(q(e)),q(e))$. Exactness gives $q(e-s_a(q(e)))=0$, hence a unique first component in the image of $u$; injectivity of $u$ makes this formula well-defined, and direct substitution using $q\circ s_a=\mathrm{id}$ shows $\Psi_a\Phi_a=\mathrm{id}$ and $\Phi_a\Psi_a=\mathrm{id}$. Thus the sequence over $U_a$ is isomorphic to the split sequence.

source.place: Proof of (*), determinant paragraph: local splitting

proof.text: The opens $U_a$ cover $X$ by construction, so the local isomorphisms establish the asserted open-cover local splitting.
